description: interlocking hexagonal tiles creating a subtle wave pattern: base colour #E0E0E0, the shapes in slightly lighter and darker shades of the base colour. It belongs to a district of the town with this look, which everything in the district shares: Bright pastel blues and sandy beiges dominate, with curved, wave‑shaped houses, light timber frames, whitewashed walls, and a breezy, relaxed seaside mood.
